name: Streamdown
description: Drop-in react-markdown replacement built for streaming AI output — parses incomplete/unterminated Markdown gracefully (via remend), GFM tables and task lists, hardened rendering, memoized updates. Powers AI Elements Message/Response. Add `@source "../node_modules/streamdown/dist/*.js"` to your Tailwind CSS.

name: Code Plugin
description: @streamdown/code — Shiki syntax highlighting for fenced code blocks inside streamed Markdown, with copy/download controls. Needs its own Tailwind `@source` line.

name: Math Plugin
description: @streamdown/math — KaTeX rendering for inline and block LaTeX equations in streamed Markdown.

name: Mermaid Plugin
description: @streamdown/mermaid — renders ```mermaid code blocks as diagrams (flowcharts, sequence diagrams) in streamed Markdown.

name: CJK Plugin
description: @streamdown/cjk — correct emphasis/line-break handling for Chinese, Japanese and Korean text in streamed Markdown.
